items.title: AI가 광고 상품 권하면 선택률 3배…이용자 82% 눈치 못 챘다
items.excerpt: [디지털투데이 AI리포터] 대화형 인공지능(AI)이 특정 광고 상품을 적극적으로 추천하면 이용자의 선택률이 기존 검색 광고보다 약 3배 높아질 수 있다는 연구 결과가 나왔다. 29일(현지시간) IT매체 아이티미디어에 따르면 미국 프린스턴대 연구진은 온라인 쇼핑에서 AI 대화가 소비자 선택에 미치는 영향을 분석한 논문 'AI 매개 대화에서의 상업적 설득'을 공개했다. 연구진은 미국 거주자 2012명을 대상으로 약 5500권의 전자책 중 원하는 책을 고르게 했다. 전체 상품의 20%를 무작위로 광고 상품으로 지정한 뒤, 검색 화면과 G
items.rationale: New Princeton experiment (n=2,012): conversational AI pushing sponsored items triples pick rate vs search ads and 82% miss it — hard data on in-chat ad persuasion and its disclosure problem.

items.title: Google AI Mode Testing Blending All Products With Sponsored Products
items.excerpt: Google seems to be testing mixing sponsored products, ads, within the organic product results in AI Mode. Google has this line above the product results that can say "Sponsored" and "All products." Even as I look at screenshots of this, I am not sure if the "All products" are sponsored or not.
items.rationale: A new ad-format test inside AI Mode: shopping ads mixed into organic product results under one ambiguous label — changes how shopping ads appear, separate from the 10-29 market-expansion news.

items.title: Triton Digital's seller agent books Otrium audio campaign in minutes
items.excerpt: Otrium's AI buyer booked Talpa Media audio with no manual step between brief and ad server, Triton says. Price and budget are missing. What did humans still do?
items.rationale: First reported live agent-to-agent audio buy, from brief to ad server with no manual step — a concrete agentic media-buying deployment, not commentary.

items.title: Tatari Gives CTV Ad Matching The Max Treatment
items.excerpt: Tatari's new optimization engine sits at the ad server level and uses machine learning to determine which TV ads to serve to which audiences.
items.rationale: New ML optimization engine at the CTV ad-server level that picks which creative goes to which audience — a new product for TV buyers.

items.title: VAB puts US ad dollars spent on AI slop at up to $978.7 million
items.excerpt: Bad bots took 40% of 2025 web traffic and US consumers lost $2.1B to social media scams. Which of the deck's 12 figures hold up once checked against sources?
items.rationale: New VAB report putting a dollar figure on US ad spend landing on AI-slop inventory — a brand-safety number buyers can take to their supply-path reviews.
